legacytextures.menu.title: Legacy Textures
legacytextures.menu.subtitle: Pick what your own game draws. Other players are not affected.
legacytextures.menu.world_note: Changing the world look reloads textures once (a few seconds).
legacytextures.preset.all_hd.help: HD for players, NB Armors and the world.
legacytextures.preset.players_hd_only.he: HD for players and NB Armors; standard world.
legacytextures.preset.reload: %s Reloads your textures once (a few seconds).
legacytextures.switch.players.help: Bodies, faces, hair, tattoos, forms and DragonMineZ armor on every player. Switches at once.
legacytextures.switch.nbarmor.help: Gis, armors and vanity outfits from NB Armors. Switches at once.
legacytextures.switch.world.help: Blocks, items and menu art. Clicking this reloads your textures once; the game pauses for a few seconds while it loads.
legacytextures.set.help.many: Click to use the next HD set. Every switch set to HD uses this set.
legacytextures.set.help.one: Only one HD set is installed. Add more in config/legacytextures/texture_sets.
legacytextures.cmd.look: Your HD switches now use the '%s' texture set. If your game does not have that set, it keeps using the standard HD set.
legacytextures.cmd.reload_note: Your game reloads its textures once to switch the world look.
legacytextures.cmd.status: Legacy Textures: %s. Players: %s, NB Armors: %s, world: %s. HD set: %s. Type /legacytextures to change it.
legacytextures.status.title: Your game (Legacy Textures %s):
legacytextures.status.hooks: Texture hooks: drawing %s, file checks %s, models %s.
legacytextures.status.cache_ok: DragonMineZ caches: all clear on each switch.
legacytextures.status.cache_bad: DragonMineZ caches that could not be cleared: %s. A switch may need F3+T until Legacy Textures is updated.
legacytextures.status.shaded_left: On the last switch DragonMineZ kept %s shaded body layer(s); Legacy Textures cleared them so bodies redraw in the new look.
legacytextures.faceanim.on: Face animation on: everyone sees you blink, and shout while you charge.
legacytextures.faceanim.off: Face animation off: your face stays still for everyone. Type /faceanim on to turn it back on.
legacytextures.faceanim.is_on: Your face animation is on. Type /faceanim off to keep your face still for everyone.
legacytextures.faceanim.is_off: Your face animation is off. Type /faceanim on to blink and shout again.
legacytextures.faceanim.player_only: Only a player can change their own face animation.
legacytextures.face.mine.help_on: My face animation: you blink, and shout while you charge. Everyone sees this, not just you. Click to keep your face still for everyone (same as /faceanim off).
legacytextures.face.mine.help_off: My face animation is off: your face stays still for everyone. Click to blink and shout again (same as /faceanim on).
legacytextures.face.mine.no_server: My face animation is stored by the server, and this server does not run Legacy Textures, so it cannot be changed here.
legacytextures.face.blink.help: Whether players' eyes blink in your game. Only your game changes; other players still see it. Switches at once.
legacytextures.face.scream.help: Whether players' mouths open into a shout while they charge, in your game. Only your game changes; other players still see it. Switches at once.
